description: Longhorn volumes, nodes, disks and IO.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Longhorn nodes known to the cluster.

panels.title: Schedulable nodes
panels.description: Nodes that are schedulable and not disabled for scheduling.

targets.expr: (count(longhorn_node_status{condition="schedulable"}==1) OR on() vector(0)) - (count(longhorn_node_status{condition="allowScheduling"}==0) OR on() vector(0))

panels.title: Disabled nodes
panels.description: Nodes with scheduling disabled.

panels.title: Failed nodes
panels.description: Nodes that are not ready.

targets.expr: (avg(longhorn_node_count_total) OR on() vector(0)) - (count(longhorn_node_status{condition="ready"}==1) OR on() vector(0))

panels.title: Volumes
panels.description: Total number of Longhorn volumes.

panels.title: Healthy volumes
panels.description: Volumes whose robustness is healthy.

panels.title: Degraded volumes
panels.description: Volumes running with fewer replicas than wanted.

panels.title: Faulted volumes
panels.description: Volumes with every replica failed.

panels.title: Node storage usage
panels.description: Used share of each node's Longhorn storage; amber from 70 %, red from 85 %.

panels.title: Node capacity
panels.description: Storage capacity of each node.

panels.title: Volumes per node
panels.description: Attached volumes on each node.

panels.title: Disk space usage
panels.description: Used share of each disk's capacity; amber from 70 %, red from 85 %.

panels.title: Disk capacity
panels.description: Capacity of each disk.

panels.title: Attached volumes
panels.description: Volumes attached to a node.

panels.title: Detached volumes
panels.description: Volumes not attached to any node.

panels.title: Volume capacity
panels.description: Provisioned capacity of each volume.

panels.title: Volume actual size / capacity
panels.description: Share of each volume's capacity that is actually used by data blocks, not the filesystem's fill level.

panels.title: Write throughput
panels.description: Write throughput of each volume.

panels.title: Read throughput
panels.description: Read throughput of each volume.

panels.title: Write IOPS
panels.description: Write operations per second of each volume.

panels.title: Read IOPS
panels.description: Read operations per second of each volume.

panels.title: Write latency
panels.description: Write latency of each volume.

panels.title: Read latency
panels.description: Read latency of each volume.

panels.title: Node CPU usage / capacity
panels.description: CPU used by Longhorn on each node, as a share of the node's capacity.

panels.title: Node memory usage / capacity
panels.description: Memory used by Longhorn on each node, as a share of the node's capacity.

panels.title: Manager CPU usage
panels.description: CPU of the Longhorn manager pods, the control plane (scheduling, attach, detach, backup).

panels.title: Manager memory usage
panels.description: Memory of the Longhorn manager pods.

panels.title: Instance manager CPU usage
panels.description: CPU of the instance managers, which run the engine and replica processes.

panels.title: Instance manager CPU usage / request
panels.description: Instance manager CPU as a share of what each requests.

panels.title: Instance manager memory usage
panels.description: Memory of the instance managers.
